flags.reason: misreads-source: Marks the main bounds part as alwaysPresent=false, but nothing in the guide supports an absent main child. The guide says "The child in the main slot establishes the size and the visual object people identify first", and both the "Badge present" and "Badge absent" states keep the main item. Only the badge-related parts are optional.

notes: /configuration/1 and /examples/0 say the default position is bottom-right. /examples/0 also says the main IconCapsule uses its default size, while the guide states it uses Icon Capsule Size M. The guide does not state either default. If both come from the package types they are fine; otherwise a human should check them. Also check that IconCapsule's default size is M, so that omitting the mode in the example matches the guide's composition.
